words.meaning: 배분하다, 나눠 배정하다 — split / divide 대신

words.meaning: (잘못된 것을) 바로잡다 — fix the mistake 대신
words.example: The contractor must rectify the wrong lug replacement before we pay.
words.collocations: rectify the problem / rectify the error

words.meaning: (범위·일정이) 겹치다, 겹침 — same part / same time 대신

patterns.pattern: I'm not in a position to ~ until ~.
patterns.meaning: ~ 전까지는 ~할 수 없습니다(아직 ~할 단계가 아닙니다) (I will not ~ yet 대신, 승인·결정을 정중히 미룰 때)
patterns.skeleton: I'm not in a position to + [동사] + until + [주어][동사]
patterns.email: I'm not in a position to approve the plan until you explain each style.
patterns.spoken: I can't approve it yet. I need the reasons first.

patterns.pattern: Since ~ was already ~, there is no need to ~ again.
patterns.meaning: 이미 ~했으므로 다시 ~할 필요는 없습니다 (We don't need ~ 대신, 이유를 붙여 범위를 줄일 때)
patterns.skeleton: Since + [주어][동사], there is no need to + [동사]
patterns.email: Since grounding resistance was already measured in September, there is no need to test it again.
patterns.spoken: We did that in September, so no need to do it again.

patterns.meaning: (합계가) ~와 맞아야 합니다 (The total must be the same 대신, 숫자 합계를 맞추라고 할 때)
patterns.email: The amounts in the note column should add up to the total difference.
patterns.spoken: These should add up to the total.
